Every gamepass, what it costs and what you get.

10 gamepasses

  • CB

    Crime Boss

    360R$£3.70
    • Increased smuggling limit: carry up to 10 smuggling items
    • Able to carry 3 Molotovs
    • Exclusive Crime Boss weapons
    • Access to the Dominus, an exclusive Crime Boss smuggling item
    • Ability to sell 2 firework boxes per in-game night
  • AW
    Best value

    Advanced Weaponry

    450R$£4.63
    • Luger
    • PKM
    • AA-12
    • AK-47
    • Tommy Gun
    Show moreShow less +5
    • AS Val
    • MP5
    • P90
    • Weapons Blueprint (smuggling item)
    • Weapon Crate (smuggling item)
  • SC

    Supercars

    360R$£3.70
    • Access to purchase multiple supercars, some of the fastest and most stylish in the game
    • Includes one free starter vehicle. Additional vehicles require in-game cash
  • BS

    Border Supervisor

    599R$£6.16

    Control the border and ensure operations run smoothly!

    • Run the border
    • Command officers
    • Set the border status
    • Access to trigger a lockdown
    • Exclusive vehicles
  • PS

    Police Specialist

    525R$£5.40

    Upgrade your police experience!

    • CTSFO
    • Access to CTSFO gear, including instant gun access
    • CTSFO Vest + Helmet (gives extra health)
    • Riot
    • Riot Gear (helmet and special uniform)
    Show moreShow less +4

    • Vehicles

    • Armed response cars
  • MP

    Military Police

    1,199R$£12.33

    Gain access to the military police team, with up to 80+ hours of content.

    • Unlocks a whole new team
    • Lots of exclusive weapons
    • Highly armoured uniform
    • Many exclusive vehicles (including an armoured patrol vehicle)
  • HT

    HART

    399R$£4.10

    Upgrade your NHS experience with specialist equipment designed to deal with any situation.

    • Get access to the HART uniform, which gives protection against firearms
    • HART-exclusive vehicles
  • GL

    Gun License

    99R$£1.02

    Gives you free guns.

    • Free guns
  • NI

    National Investigations Agency

    399R$£4.10

    Become a NIA Agent and keep the border protected!

    • Unlock access to exclusive gear
    • Specialist uniforms

    • Instant and exclusive firearm

    Bypass Team Limits

    399R$£4.10

        Website officially in beta testing

        We are excited to announce that the new Eurotunnel Wiki web platform is officially live in beta testing.

        Our team has overhauled the site architecture for fast loading, a deep electric-blue matte theme and streamlined layouts built for border roleplay members.

        What to expect during beta

        • Wiki sections are being populated and are marked as coming soon.
        • Interface and style refinements are rolling out continuously.
        • Join the Discord server to send feedback or report bugs.
